iv. Shrubs & Groundcovers: per UDC Section 6.3, Table 6-9, except that points shall be awarded for only
            shrubs, flowering perennials, ornamental grasses, or functional turf grass.
        v. Recommended Plant Materials for Irrigated Landscapes: (see Table 4 below)
             Table 4: Recommended Plant Materials for Irrigated Landscapes
              Recommended Tree Species for Irrigated Landscapes
              Any Species identified in the most current City of Cheyenne Urban Forestry
              Guidelines and Best Practices for Tree Planting in Cheyenne
              Acer tataricum                       Tatarian Maple
              Acer negundo 'Sensation'             Sensation Maple (Male clone that
                                                   does not attract boxelder bugs)
              Celtis occidentalis                  Hackberry
              Crataegus ambigua                    Russian Hawthorn
              Gymnocladus dioica                   Kentucky Coffeetree
              Malus spp.                           Crabapple (Fireblight resistant
                                                   varieties only)
              Pinus nigra                          Austrian Pine
              Quercus macrocarpa                   Burr Oak
              (Other tree species may be proposed, so long as they are drought
              tolerant, disease resistant, and suitable for the climate in Cheyenne.)

              Recommended Shrub Species for Irrigated Landscapes
              All shrub species identified in Naturalized Landscapes (above)
              Additional species may be approved on a case-by-case basis, so long as
              they have been identified as being moderately water consumptive or less.
        vi. Irrigation and Maintenance: per UDC Sections 6.3.7 and 6.3.8, unless otherwise specified herein.



(End of Section)
